title: Microsoft Teams: custom backgrounds for town halls in Manage what attendees see
summary: The rollout details, default state and documented town hall controls are supported, and the briefing correctly reports Microsoft's conflicting licence descriptions. The assertion that nobody reviews an image before attendees see it is not established by the sources. Narrow the wording about the sole admin switch and retain the notice's expected rollout wording.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn has no page documenting this specific town hall event-screen upload feature at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams town hall Manage what attendees see upload custom backgrounds; town hall custom backgrounds admin production. Opened plan-events and read custom-meeting-backgrounds excerpts; these cover production access or individual video backgrounds, not this event-screen upload.

claims.claim: Nobody reviews an uploaded image before attendees see it.
claims.quote: Searched: Manage what attendees see approval background; town hall Manage what attendees see upload custom backgrounds admin approval policy. Read MC1307982, plan-events and custom-meetings-overview excerpts; none establishes that nobody reviews images.
claims.fix: Remove ", and nobody reviews that image before attendees see it". The absence of a documented admin review step does not establish that no person reviews the image.

go to Meetings > Events policies.

To prevent organizers with this policy from creating events optimized for large audiences, run the following command:
